title: Stellar: Systematic Evaluation of Human-Centric Personalized Text-to-Image Methods

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the preservation of the input subject's gender in generated images using linear classifiers on face embeddings to compute an Attribute Preservation Score (APS), ensuring models do not alter the subject's gender based on context prompts. Additionally, the evaluation dataset is explicitly curated to be balanced and unbiased across sex.

Additionally, the evaluation dataset is explicitly curated to be balanced and unbiased across age.
